description:
Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration interface (https://localhost/openmrs/admin). Log in with username 'superman' and password 'Admin123'. 

Your task is to retire a specific healthcare provider who is no longer with the hospital.

1. Find the provider 'Dr. Temporary Provider' (Identifier: PROV-TEMP).
2. Retire this provider record.
3. Enter the reason: 'Contract Ended'.

Ensure the provider is successfully marked as retired in the system.
